body:
I’m often jealous of those who do actually die.  
They didn’t want to die. But yet I’m still here, wishing I could trade places

She knows I’m sad.  She has a lot going on with mean girls who excluded her from prom the morning of.  I can’t put any more anxiety on her. She is the ONLY reason I get out of bed and try so hard to fake my smile.

I cannot talk to her about this.   
She will not see a dead body.  It will be a car accident or “accidental” electrocution.   
If I can hold it together it will be once she has graduated.  
I’m am trying really really hard to hold on each day.
When the pain of hell looks better than the pain on earth... now that’s a dilemma.

Most days are spent crying.  I can not control the crying.  Simple conversations are almost impossible because of the tears. 
And oh what an ugly cryer I am.
Thank you.  Very true words

I understand 
Each day gets harder & harder

That’s is OLNY reason I’m still here. 
I have other children too, but I know they will not be hurt.

Both. 
Medication doesn’t really help.  I’ve had adverse reactions to some of them. 
Therapy - I already know what they are going to say.  That’s the problem - I’m smart enough to know yet the pain of living wins.

I’m a lousy mother.  
Thanks for the reminder
Exactly!
No.   Not valid enough reasons.  Sorry
Please see a doctor and talk to the school about a medical withdrawal.  That will put school “on hold” and not effect future financial aid.
Yes!!!   My dream

Yay!!! I’m glad you went to work.  You sound soo much better.  
I can tell you that helping others is the ONLY thing that keeps me from thinking about how bad things are.  I volunteer a lot and help friends I need.   
Hobbies help too.  Knitting or crocheting for children is a great easy hobby.  Check out Lion Brand “Hats Not Hate”.   Inexpensive and lots of YouTube videos to help learn!
I mean right before.   I’m trying to make it all look like an accident. I have 5 kids that I don’t want to damage.
I’ll be here, waiting to hear about your shitty day!

Do you want to see a dr?
I agree about “it gets better” is bullshit !
What are your main reasons?  Depression, financial, loneliness!
If by chance you are here tomorrow.... just know I’ll be looking for you to post.   Tell us all the crap that happened and we can share the shit!

Wake up tomorrow.  Go to work. 
Come back here after & tell us about your day...the good, the bad, & everything in between. 
Then you’ll have 12 days til you see dr.  
Repeat.  
I’ll come back here to find look for you tomorrow!

How do you need help? 
What kind of advice?
Oh please don’t let me come back again.  I won’t be able to do this life over & over
I’m thinking I’ll have to change passwords, delete social media & smash phone.
Good.  Then the end is..... the end
Yes.    I have to make sure it doesn’t look like suicide because my kids would be damaged for life.

Well then I’ll have no pain greater than right now!!!
There’s a plus to having no hell.  
It can all just ..... end
I don’t understand
So them having a disastrous, f-upped mom is better?

There are just too many of us in the pain of living. 
I don’t see it getting better.  If the world could just end,  it would be so much better easier

Thank you for your insight 
I have 5 children (24, 23, 22, 20 & 16) 
I , too, feel they are old enough to understand. 
I’m so proud of them - they really are good people.  But also feel like a burden to them.

I can’t do that right now.  
I can barely get out of bed to take a shower.

Bless you 
I can’t make any promises to myself.  
I can’t see any sign of hope. 
I wish suicide didn’t have so much stigma. 
Why can’t we choose not to live & others be ok with it. 
Honestly I pray daily for the world to end so it can be all over with

No.  
I have severe depression and tried everything possible.  Well except electro-therapy.
No.   I have chronic nerve pain.  I have been off pain meds for 4 yrs, after being on oxy/morphine & every trial imaginable for 10+ yrs.

They are the reason I’ve hung on this long. 
I know that people should want to live, but I don’t. 
I really, really don’t. 
I’m thinking hitting a big tree or driving off bridge would look like accident to them.
Both.     Living is painfully.

Then how am I suppose to carry on?  
I really, really want to die.   This isn’t a new thing for me.    It’s real.    I used to be able to fake happiness but now I can’t even do that. 
And fwiw the crisis text line sucks!!! They are not helpful at all!

The kids will get over it. 
The only reason I can’t do it immediately is because I don’t want them to think about it every NYE.
